faqs.question: What is AI app development?
faqs.answer: AI app development is the process of building software that uses artificial intelligence to interpret data, recognize patterns, make predictions, understand language, or personalize an experience.

faqs.question: What kinds of AI applications can you build?
faqs.answer: We build AI-powered mobile and web applications, virtual assistants, recommendation systems, predictive analytics tools, computer vision products, and AI features integrated into existing apps.

faqs.question: How do AI applications work?
faqs.answer: AI applications process data using selected models and algorithms, then use the results to power features such as predictions, search, recommendations, automation, and natural language interactions.

faqs.question: Can you add AI features to an existing mobile application?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can assess your application and integrate suitable AI features while preserving the existing product experience and systems.

faqs.question: How do you choose the AI technology for an app?
faqs.answer: We consider the product use case, available data, response quality, privacy, latency, device requirements, integration effort, and operating cost before recommending an approach.

faqs.question: Can AI apps integrate with cloud services?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI applications can use AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or hybrid infrastructure depending on your security, scalability, and deployment requirements.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build an AI app?
faqs.answer: A focused MVP may take several weeks, while a production application with custom models, integrations, and platform requirements can take several months. Scope and data readiness determine the schedule.

faqs.question: How much does an AI application cost?
faqs.answer: Cost depends on product scope, data, model requirements, integrations, platforms, and compliance needs. We define an estimate after reviewing your goals and requirements.

faqs.question: How do you test AI application quality?
faqs.answer: We evaluate the application against real user scenarios, checking model quality, usability, security, performance, reliability, and the behavior of integrations.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after an AI app launches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ongoing support can include monitoring, updates, model and data improvements, security maintenance, and optimization based on product usage.
